reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: PRASAC, an existing FMO client, is converting from a regulated deposit-taking MFI into a commercial bank, with the main objective of further strengthening its funding sources and pursuing sustained growth and commercial expansion. As part of this process it will also need to strengthen its organization, for example by further developing risk management and management information systems. FMO will support this conversion through the Capacity Development Program. The management – supported and approved by the Board in March 2013 – has nominated the Frankfurt School of Finance and Management as the consultant throughout this process, phased over the coming 12 months. During the process, there will be proactive interaction with both the management and the Board.
